lines.text: Paul says his readers were dead in their trespasses and sins and followed the ways of this world.
All of us once fulfilled the cravings of our flesh and were by nature children of wrath.
Because of His great love, God made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses.
God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in Jerusalem, to display the riches of His grace.
We are saved by grace through faith, not by works, and created in Christ Jesus to sing His praises.
